Novel Ni70-xCo10Cr20Alx (x = 17, 18, 19 at%) EHESs with the density of 7.3 – 7.5 g/cm3 have been designed. As the Al content increases, the alloy transforms from hypo-eutectic to eutectic and then to hyper-eutectic. Al18 alloy processes the lamellar heterogeneous structure consisting of FCC and B2 phases with the nano-scale L12 and disordered Cr-rich BCC phase precipitated from the FCC matrix and the B2 phase, respectively.

mechanisms.material_state: as-cast, tensile tested at ambient temperature

evidence.quote: As the strain increases, the strengthening effect of back stress becomes more pronounced than that of effective stress, increasing from 409 MPa to 673 MPa, thereby dominating the strengthening mechanism.

The ambient and high temperature strengthening effect can be attributed to three possible factors: the solid solution strengthening of Al, HDI hardening of finer eutectic lamellar structure, and precipitation strengthening of high-density thermally stable ordered L12 and disordered BCC nano-precipitates.
